intro.text:
Hi.
I've prepared
something for you.
Do you want to see it?

map.title:
Each
little light —
one step closer

letter.content:
I love you very much.

And I thank God
that you are in my life.

For the fact that one day
you wrote to me:

"Hello, Viktoria" —
and our story began.

I am grateful to you
for your support.

For always being there
for my dreams,
for my new beginnings.

For always telling me
that my drawings are beautiful.
That I will succeed.

It means so much to me.
Thank you, my sunshine.

I am grateful to you for your help,
for your care,
for your selflessness toward me.

You always put my wishes above your own.

Thank you.

I am very sorry
that sometimes I can be rude,
indifferent,
and blind toward you.

Forgive me for that.
But I love you.

I love you with all my heart.
And I will change for you —
and I already believe that I am changing.

Thank you for your patience and for all your
"I forgive you"s.

I love you, my treasure.

May this day not become
just another sorrow for you
and a day of sad memories.

May it be filled
with our warm,
shared memories.
